column1: # The maintainer's exceptions to the names base (source «editor»): written as grammar, by the maintainer.
# names: a link of the sources that is plainly wrong — base empty: the name is a name of its own.
# forms: a form the rules of verso.ru.naming.forms do not give; an empty cell is the rule's.
# drop: a Wikidata label that is no given name (left out of the base) — note: why.
# patronymics: a short form the rules give two names — name: the form, base: its father, patronymic_m (a man's)
#   or patronymic_f (a woman's): its modern form.
